milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate toward the birch trees and face them, confirming visual identification. The target is set to the center of the birch grove at (10, 2, 10) spawn-relative. max_distance=5 requires the player to walk at least ~9 blocks from spawn toward the birch grove (since the target is ~14.3 blocks from spawn), ensuring genuine navigation. facing_tolerance=60° ensures the player is actually looking toward the birch trees, not just standing nearby with their back turned.

Uses inventory_has because chopping trees (mining birch_log blocks) causes birch_log items to drop and enter the player's inventory. The player starts with no birch_log in inventory (only an iron_axe), so having at least 1 birch_log confirms they successfully chopped a birch tree. This is the preferred rule type for mine/chop tasks since the item ends up in inventory.
